cues.text: Hello?
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Hi Liz, it’s Ken here.
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Hi Ken! Nice to hear from you! Are you ...
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: This is just a quick call, but Mary and I have just been talking about our summer holiday - we haven’t booked a place yet and we’ve left it a bit late. We were just wondering if you know of any holiday rentals in your area - it’s so nice there.
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Well yes, I can think of two or three places that are very nice - what dates have you got in mind?
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Example The 10th of July to the 22nd of July.
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Oh yes, that is quite soon isn’t it? Well there’s a place near here called  Moonfleet ...
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Is that M-double O- N-F-L-double E- T?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: That’s right. It’s quite a rural location, and it’s next to the owner’s house, but it’s got fields all around it, so it’s very pretty.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Mm. Sounds OK. Can you tell me a bit more about it?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Well it’s an annexe to the owner’s house, and it’s an apartment with two bedrooms, and an open-plan living area.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Well I like the sound of it. Is there anything we might not like about it?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Well it’s quite a distance from the nearest shops, that’s all ...
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: OK. And ... well, I’ll tell Mary but I don’t think she’d mind that. Do you know how you book it?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: You have to book on the internet. There’s a web address - it’s www. summerhouses ...
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: One word?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Yes ... Then dot com. You’ll be able to look at a photograph on that.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: OK . And what about the others? Where are they?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: The second one I’m thinking of is called Kingfisher, and that’s even more rural. It’s a really beautiful location in fact, it’s by the Q5 river, and it’s got nice views - it overlooks woodland on the other side.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Is that an apartment?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: No, it’s a three-bedroomed house. And that’s got a Q6 dining room as well as a separate living room and a kitchen. But I expect it’s more expensive. You’ll have to check the prices.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Mm. It’s probably a bit bigger than we need, but our nephew might be joining us, we’re not sure yet. How do you book Kingfisher?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: You have to phone the owner directly. Shall I give you the number? I’ve got it here in my phone book ... It’s oh one seven five two, double six nine, two one eight.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Right ...
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: And you mentioned a third place?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Yes, there’s a house that my sister stayed in last year - it’s called Sunnybanks.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Nice name.
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: And the location of that one is rather different ... It’s in the centre of a village, but it’s a very small and quaint place.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Did your sister like it?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: Oh yes, it’s by the sea so her children really loved it ...
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: What’s the accommodation like?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: I’m not sure about the number of rooms because I haven’t been in it myself, but I think she said it’s quite spacious ... And I know it’s got its own garden. It’s not very big, but it’s not shared with anyone else, and it’s supposed to be very pretty.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Any snags? Problems?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: The only other thing I can think of is that there’s nowhere for parking. The streets are too narrow. So you have to leave your car somewhere else and then walk to the house - it’s only about ten minutes away, but ...
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: OK. Well ... I don’t think it matters personally. How do you book it?
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: There’s an agent you have to contact. I don’t know his details, but I can ask my sister and let you know tomorrow.
cues.speaker: Liz

cues.text: Thanks Liz, that’d be great. I’ll talk to Mary and see what she says. Thanks for your help.
cues.speaker: Ken

cues.text: That’s OK Ken, I’ll speak to you again tomorrow. I hope you find what you’re looking for ...
cues.speaker: Liz
